parameters.name: App
parameters.description: The application name for the output stream of the monitoring session. You can specify a custom name. If you do not specify this parameter, **monitor** is used as the AppName.

parameters.name: CallbackUrl
parameters.description: The webhook address. HTTP and HTTPS are supported.

parameters.name: DingTalkWebHookUrl
parameters.description:
The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot. Monitoring alerts are sent to a DingTalk group using a chatbot. Set up a chatbot and enter its webhook URL, which must be an HTTP or HTTPS address. For more information, see [Custom robot access](https://open.dingtalk.com/document/robots/custom-robot-access).

> Set the custom keyword of the DingTalk chatbot to "Alerting". Otherwise, messages cannot be received.

parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: The output domain name for the monitoring session.

parameters.name: InputList
parameters.description: The list of input streams to monitor. For more information, see the **InputConfig** table below.

parameters.name: MonitorConfig
parameters.description: The settings for alert thresholds. The value is a JSON string. For more information, see the MonitorConfig table below.

parameters.name: MonitorId
parameters.description:
The ID of the monitoring session.

> Obtain the MonitorId value from the response parameters of the [CreateLiveStreamMonitor](~~2848129~~) operation.

parameters.name: MonitorName
parameters.description: The name of the monitoring session.

parameters.name: OutputTemplate
parameters.description:
The output template for the monitoring session. Valid values:

- **lp\_ld**: low definition.

- **lp\_sd**: standard definition.

- **lp\_hd**: high definition.

- **lp\_ud**: ultra-high definition.

parameters.name: Stream
parameters.description: The name of the output stream for the monitoring session.
